prompts.dance_robot: Create an exact 4x4 animation sprite grid of 16 full-body frames for the SILVER ROBOT AT BOTTOM LEFT of attached reference. This image is a character reference. Complete its body in same restrained 1970s anime cel style: silver rounded black-visor helmet with mustard earpieces, silver articulated limbs, muted coral chest chevron, charcoal waist, elegant silver boots. Slim humanoid proportions, not muscular. ONE identical robot, fixed orthographic frontal three-quarter camera, identical scale and design in all cells. Every figure entirely inside own cell. Genuinely transparent alpha background with no painted background, no shadows, no grid lines, no labels, no text. Generous clear margin. Keep ground level and pelvis center consistent. Sixteen successive poses in a smooth relaxed funky robot dance 4-beat loop, row-major chronological. Row1: knees bend with weight left and elbows gradually rise from waist to chest, right wrist pops. Row2: weight shifts center then right, left forearm moves outward, robot leans right by slight hip shift. Row3: left foot taps out and body returns, both arms gradually make a soft angular wave at chest height, hands articulated. Row4: elbows lower, knees rebound, weight returns to left as both arms lead into first pose. Adjacent frames should vary modestly, no random pose jumps, last pose connects first. Natural coherent joints, every frame different in arms and legs. Restrained flat painted highlights and one cel-shadow shape. Opaque clean character silhouettes, fully transparent empty canvas. Square sheet exactly 4 columns by4 rows.
prompts.dance_room: A VERTICAL 9:16 hand-painted background plate for a nostalgic 1970s Japanese space-opera anime music video. EMPTY ROOM, NO CHARACTERS, NO PEOPLE, NO ROBOTS, NO TEXT. Interior of a small retro orbital discotheque: one gigantic curved rounded rectangular observation window in upper half, rich muted deep-steel-blue space beyond with a few fine stars and the curve of a dusty blue distant planet. Warm ochre arch framing window, side walls in desaturated aubergine and dusty mauve, a few hand-painted simple vertical architectural shapes. Lower 40 percent: broad clear matte burgundy dance floor in subtle perspective, muted horizontal panel seams; no neon grid. A low rounded raised platform at floor center. Composition designed so full-body dancers can be layered centrally, open uncluttered middle. Camera looking straight across room, floor baseline for dancers around 70 percent frame height. Actual old animation-background look: flat gouache paint, soft minimal brush texture, muted pigment colors, hard graphic shadows, subtle cel-film softness, no glossy rendering, no glows, no synthwave sun, no modern neon, no gradients dominating. Cinematic and cozy, restrained and slightly mysterious, enough light that silver, ochre and dusty pink cel-animated figures read clearly. Viewport portrait composition.
